subsections.title: The PI and Trial & IRB Coordinator will provide updates and changes to the plan in the annual RPPR. The PI, Trial & IRB Coordinator, and Statistician/Data Manager will meet monthly in all years of the project to ensure that the datasets, protocols, and codes are being prepared for sharing into the data repository once the main outcome manuscript has been published. The Statistician/Data Manager will work closely with the University of California San Diego Library repository manager to ensure that the datasets, protocols, and code are correctly stored and available for sharing.
